name: 文本检索：生成、召回、教师评分与负例

columns.name: qa
columns.system_prompt: Return only a JSON object. Do not include explanations or reasoning.

columns.name: judge
columns.system_prompt: Evaluate the question honestly. Return only JSON with overall (an integer from 0 to 10) and reason. 9-10: precise, self-contained, fully supported; 7-8: supported with a minor issue; 4-6: vague or partly unsupported; 0-3: unsupported or incoherent. Do not inflate scores.

processors.expr: judge.overall >= 7 and negatives | length >= 1 and false_negative_suspects | length == 0
